description: React component for advanced user settings in Mattermost, including preferences for message sending, formatting, account deactivation, and other advanced options.

classes.name: AdvancedSettingsDisplay
classes.description: React component managing advanced user settings, including preferences, account deactivation, and UI sections.

methods.name: getStateFromProps
methods.description: Initializes component state based on props.

methods.description: Updates a specific setting in the component state.

methods.description: Saves updated preferences to the server.
